verdict.rationale: LightSprint says every task gets its own isolated sandbox, a full-stack environment with a branched database when needed, where cloud agents build and preview changes without affecting production. Admins can control and monitor which external services agents reach from those sandboxes, and an onboarding agent sets up the environment and setup script. All of this comes from marketing-level claims, and dependency installation is only implied. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of dependency installation inside the sandbox, technical detail on the isolation mechanism, independent or hands-on corroboration.
